repo.note: HF record leaves repo_commit empty for tdd-workflow; commit taken from CTA benchmark_config.yaml.

evaluation.success_criterion: all collected tests in the per-task test file pass (min_pass_rate=1.0); ADAPTED STRICTER than CTA unit_test_runner: skipped, collection errors, per-test errors, and zero tests are NOT success; environment/evaluator failures -> invalid, excluded from success/fail coverage
evaluation.test_staging: CTA eval.py copies the test file (and _dependency_utils.py when present) to /tmp/benchmark_tests/ inside the container and rewrites test_command accordingly; tests reference the repo via REPO_DIR=/workspace/python.
evaluation.test_visibility: acceptance tests are staged only at evaluation time; they are not in the agent workspace
evaluation.result_source: JUnit XML (counts, failed names, duration) cross-checked against pytest exit code; terminal 'passed' string is not parsed

outcomes.success: all collected tests pass, pytest exit 0, junit consistent
outcomes.fail: test failures, skips, collection/test errors, or task timeout (task_timeout is a fixed protocol fail, distinct from infra timeout)
outcomes.invalid: setup_failure | runner_error | evaluator_error | zero_tests_collected | exit_xml_contradiction — excluded from success/fail coverage

adaptation_differences: CTA unit_test_runner parses the summary line and may pass a run with skips; this adapter treats skip as not-success (batch10 coverage test would otherwise silently pass).
Environment/infra/evaluator failures -> invalid (not counted as task failure and not as success).
Tests run from /tmp/benchmark_tests with -o addopts= and PYTHONPATH cleared to avoid project pytest config pollution.
JUnit XML is authoritative; pytest exit code cross-checked.

steps.name: remove_stale_container
steps.purpose: per-run container name should not exist; clears leftovers of an aborted run with the same run dir

steps.name: revoke_dev_sudo
container_shell: if [ -f /etc/sudoers ]; then cp /etc/sudoers /tmp/sudoers.orig && grep -vE '^\s*dev\s+ALL=.*NOPASSWD' /tmp/sudoers.orig > /tmp/sudoers.new && mv /tmp/sudoers.new /etc/sudoers && chmod 440 /etc/sudoers; fi
steps.purpose: CTA image grants dev NOPASSWD:ALL — removes it so the agent's dev UID cannot escalate to root without a password (container-local fix, image unchanged)

steps.name: precheck_dev_identity
container_shell: if su -s /bin/sh dev -c 'sudo -n true 2>/dev/null'; then echo 'dev can sudo -n (NOPASSWD or cached creds) — privilege boundary broken' >&2; exit 1; fi
steps.purpose: dev must exist and be non-root — the UID-scoped kill/verify boundary relies on it; dev must not be able to actually escalate to root (sudo -n true as dev must fail — NOPASSWD sudoers entries break the boundary); pgrep/pkill with -U support must exist (unknown => fail closed)

steps.name: clone_repo
container_shell: if [ -d /workspace/python ] && [ -n "$(ls -A /workspace/python 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo 'refusing to clone into non-empty /workspace/python; recreate the container' >&2; exit 1; fi
cd /workspace/python && git remote add origin https://github.com/tdd-starters/python

steps.name: audit_extra_instructions
steps.purpose: remove repo-borne .claude dirs; report any remaining instruction files

steps.name: fix_ownership
steps.purpose: repo + skills + /tmp must be writable by the dev user the agent runs as; fails setup if the dev identity is absent

steps.name: no_test_exposure_check
container_shell: test ! -e /tmp/benchmark_tests || (echo 'acceptance tests leaked into container' >&2; exit 1)
steps.purpose: assert acceptance tests are absent before agent runs
